# ForceOp

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** ForceOp

## What it does

Cracks AuthMe passwords. Can be used to get OP.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

**Scope note:** Wurst describes an AuthMe password attack. AuthMe is a third-party authentication plugin; this is not a stock vanilla operator bypass. See the 26.3 [permission audit](../../exploits/permission-boundaries.md).
